svg.text: Untargeted 1D NMR Metabolomics: PCA Hotelling T^2, OPLS-DA S-Plot & STOCSY
AIB + PQN + Pareto cohort (N=24) · OPLS-DA Q^2 = 0.977 (perm p <= 1/101 (0.0099, 100-perm floor)) · Synthetic forward-model showcase
A. PCA Score Space & 95% Hotelling T^2 (PC1 66.2%, PC2 9.8%)
B. OPLS-DA Wiklund S-Plot (Cov(t_p, X) vs p(corr))
C. STOCSY Driver Correlation Spectrum (Driver = 1.330 ppm -> L-Lactate (bmse000036, score=1.00))
